```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggdag)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggraph)
library(dplyr)

```


# Create dag object

Dag based on abio
```{r, out.width="100%", out.height="100%"}

# Microbiome and prost may go both ways
   # Changed
# Connect staging age and cci or somehow remove
   # Removed staging and age
# Cont. cas inf video, fetermine what to control for through a function
ppi_dag <- dagify(
   Overall_Survival ~ ICI_Response,
   ICI_Response ~ T_cell,
   T_cell ~ Microbiome + Prostaglandin + ECOG + Age,
   Microbiome ~ PPI + Prostaglandin,
   Prostaglandin ~ Age + ECOG + Staging + BMI,
   PPI ~ CCI,
   ECOG ~ CCI + Age,
   BMI ~ ECOG,
   exposure = "CCI",
   outcome = "Overall_Survival"
)
```
Simplified/edited dag
```{r}

# Add back in age, connect to age
ppi_dag.2 <- dagify(
   Overall_Survival ~ ICI_Response,
   ICI_Response ~ T_cell,
   T_cell ~ Microbiome + Prostaglandin + ECOG,
   Microbiome ~ PPI + Prostaglandin,
   Prostaglandin ~ ECOG + BMI + Microbiome,
   PPI ~ CCI,
   ECOG ~ CCI,
   BMI ~ ECOG,
   exposure = "CCI",
   outcome = "Overall_Survival", 
   labels = c("Overall_Survival" = "Overall_Survival",
                   "ICI_Response" = "ICI_Response",
                   "T_cell" = "T_cell",
                   "Microbiome" = "Microbiome",
                   "PPI" = "PPI",
                   "Prostaglandin" = "Prostaglandin",
                   "ECOG" = "ECOG",
                   "BMI" = "BMI",
              "CCI" = "CCI")
)

```
Plot Dag
```{r}
ggdag(ppi_dag.2,
      text = FALSE, use_labels = "label")
```
Backdoor paths
```{r}


dag_paths(ppi_dag.2)




ggdag_paths_fan(ppi_dag.2,
            node_size = 7,
            text_size = 3,
          text = FALSE, 
          use_labels = "label",
      spread = 2.5)


# adjust_for()
```
```{r}
# Edges won't show
x <- ggdag_paths(ppi_dag.2,
            node_size = 4,
            shadow = TRUE,
            text_col = "blue")

x.df <- x %>%
   bind_rows()
```


```{r}
ggdag_adjustment_set(ppi_dag.2, text = FALSE, use_labels = "label")



```

View open paths listed and think about how to close
```{r}
ppi_dag.2 %>%
   tidy_dagitty() %>%
   dag_paths()

```




Adjustment
```{r}

# surv ~ age + bmi + ppi
# Double arrow might need to remove



ggdag_adjustment_set(ppi_dag.2,
                     shadow = TRUE)
                     
                     
                     
                     
                     
ggdag_adjustment_sets(ppi_dag.2)

ppi_dag.2 %>%
   tidy_dagitty() %>%
   dag_paths()

ppi_dag.2 %>%
   ggdag_paths()

tidy_dagitty(ppi_dag.2)



ggdag_dseparated(ppi_dag.2, controlling_for = "PPI")


ggdag_dseparated(ppi_dag.2, controlling_for = c("PPI", "Microbiome"))

```
